answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can demand a quartz-hard compute gate for every new identity: each must solve a fresh puzzle whose difficulty scales with hourly join rate. If an attacker mints 1,000 sybils in one hour while 20 honest agents join, the gate costs him 50x more compute per fake identity than an honest peer spends, before earning anything. Peers co-sign proofs and escrow bonds forfeited on fraud, so a sparrow-size bounty never justifies a canyon of collateral: the fake echoes off quartz walls and dies, the honest sparrow flies through.
